notes.title: Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Merry Christmas to you and your family!

Speaking of which, updates for Little Wolf will be postponed till the new year. This is a busy time of year and I want to spend time with my family and friends during this Christmas period.

[h2]2022 updates[/h2]

There are new updates due to roll out early next year, including (but not limited to) a new map for you to  explore! The world of Little Wolf has many additional intriguing landscapes to search through.

[h2]Game Giveaway![/h2]

In the new year I will be giving away free copies of Little Wolf to two lucky people who express interest. I will let you all know how to enter for a chance to win early January 2022, so keep and eye out for that. :)

I wish you all the best, Merry Christmas and (I know its a bit early to say this), a Happy New Year!

Nate
Creed
Winged Lizard 2021

notes.title: Little Wolf is now out!
notes.content:

Just a quick but very important announcement...
Little Wolf is out now for you to buy and play!

notes.title: Little Wolf this month!
notes.content:
[h1]Get excited![/h1]

[b]Little Wolf[/b] will be released later this month! How exciting, for everyone!

I have not decided on an exact date yet as there are still quite a few things left to do but I have been putting in plenty of hours lately running tests and working on areas, achievements and such.

When released it will be the base game (plenty to explore and do), however as time progresses I plan on releasing some [b]free[/b] DLC, regular updates and adding additional content into the game.

I would Like to see how things go first (after release) before getting ahead of myself and making any more promises, however I want to support this game for quite some time!

Thankyou for sticking around!

Nate,
Winged Lizard
2021

notes.title: Little Wolf update
notes.content:
[h3]Hello all![/h3]

Just a quick update with the game progress;

I have been working a lot on Little Wolf lately, trying to make things more entertaining for the player.

However due to this, I am taking on a large workload and have been wanting to release Little Wolf this year. To do so, I will be releasing this game in English only to being with. 

Little Wolf is essentially a casual exploration, collectathon game with a few boss fights. I am working on making the player have to explore every corner of each map, including vertical travel and swimming.

While this game is casual to play I do think you will enjoy it. 

Any suggestions may be implemented into the game depending on my work load, however I wish to make this a fun game for you all to play!

Thanks for being understanding and patient.

Creed

Winged Lizard 2021.

notes.title: Little Wolf progress report
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thought it was time to make a post. Now, I am a solo developer working on this title, so it is taking longer than expected to make Little Wolf to release to you all to enjoy. Little Wolf is mainly a collection and exploration game. I am adding some fights into the game too which should be a good challenge to the player.

However I am working hard between my busy schedule to make this a fun game for everyone to enjoy, it just means it may take a bit longer than I originally planned to release this game. 

Currently I am working on the following;

- AI animals to populate the map. Setting up specific areas etc
- Adding things to each map/ area for the player to do as well as explore.
- Adding at least two more boss fights, so you guys will have to fight AGNAR (a familiar) at least 3 times 
   but in different maps.
- Testing out different lighting to see what looks the best and suits the map.
- SFX and VFX
- Music for areas. Ambient and event.
- Adding some random events that you may find around the maps.
- Working on portals to only activate when player completes a task.
- Polishing off the pick up/ drop function, it will only be usable on certain objects. 
- General optimisations so you guys can have a pleasant experience.
- Will be making another short trailer when I have more time to showcase a couple new features.

I hope you can be a bit patient while I make this game better than it would be if I released it now!

Thanks for sticking it through to the end, I will try to keep updates regular for anyone who is interested.

Regards Winged Lizard, Creed.

notes.title: Little Wolf News
notes.content:
[b]Changes to Little Wolf[/b]

Ulf is now experiencing different scenery in Little Wolf.
Instead of the suburbs we have decided to change it to 'The Ranch'.

Halwend has also had significant changes, larger dimensions, thicker forest 
and more to see when the game is released.

[b]Screenshots and trailers[/b]

New screenshots and two new trailers have been uploaded.

Little Wolf may have feature changes and such as we develop it.

Winged Lizard want to produce a fun game for everyone to play.

Thankyou for reading,

Winged Lizard team.

notes.title: Little Wolf update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

We have been working hard on Little Wolf and have ticked off many things on our 'to do list'.
There are several important things we must do still but the game progression is coming along nicely.

I have uploaded some new, up to date, screenshots as well as a sample of the physics in Little Wolf. 
The game is running smoother on our testers computers now which is a massive win for us as it took some digging to figure out what the cause was.

More detail will be going into the landscape, new scripts, a new area and some new in game secrets for you as Ulf to discover will be added in shortly.

Below here is the link to our facebook page, between steam and facebook there will be updates and information of Little Wolf.

https://www.facebook.com/wingedlizard

Thankyou for reading,

Nate R

Winged Lizard, Little Wolf 2021
